integrity: Self-contained algebraic argument and reproducible finite checks; calculations support but do not replace general proof. Not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Fourth-power extension for the two coordinate-subgroup union only, with |H| at least five; no optimal constant determined for orders two, three or four; no stability remainder quantified. Earliest motivating public preprint is arxiv:1806.11387 first announced 2018-06-29.
title: Sharp fourth-moment extension and one-axis rigidity for finite abelian crosses
